reason: I already pay for a monitoring service that watches my key client pages, so this would replace something that works. I'd poke at the free tier for a client handoff, but I'm not moving my client monitoring onto a brand-new app with zero reviews.
objection: It's brand new with no reviews, so I don't know if it'll still be around next year. That also makes the $99 lifetime deal feel like a bet, not a bargain, and pasting my clients' browser sessions into an unknown tool makes me nervous.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of it running with real reviews from other freelancers, plus a free trial of Studio so I can run a full client site on all devices and compare it with what I use now.
